title: Position: From Noise to Signal to Selbstzweck - Reframing Human Label Variation in the Era of Post-training in NLP
reasoning: The paper centers on human pluralism, the ethical alignment of AI with diverse human values, and the concept of 'Selbstzweck' (intrinsic value). It critiques how current datasets flatten human perspectives and argues for a framework that treats diverse human moral and societal viewpoints as essential for ethical AI development.
